description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Mahaloluwa, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.  511001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classification details. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
